facts.fact: The Ministry of Health communique of 21 July 2026 says the Identifiant National de Sante, a unique personal health code, is being generalised progressively across all public health structures and university hospitals, after a pilot in reference hospitals that the ministry calls fully successful.

The ministry says the Sahetna.tn national citizen health platform is in final technical configuration, with a unified shared medical record to move clinical data between emergency departments and operating theatres.
